name: Peresznye (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light grey at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Peresznye: a white and green shield with a tree, a squirrel and a sun, above a yellow scroll inscribed PERESZNYE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
